description: Agent Childcare Records: submit childcare inspection records, the licensing agency’s inspection record itself, with the schedule, violations, corrections and the facility record’s rooms and age groups they answer to: the reading moment; each room the facility record identifies with its id, reference, name and the age group it serves; each inspection the record’s own schedule requires with its id, reference, the room and the moments its window opens and it is due; each inspection entry with its id, reference, the room and age group inspected, the licensing inspector and the moment inspected; each violation with its id, reference, the inspection entry, the moment cited and the moment correction is due; each correction entry with its id, reference, the violation and the moment corrected. The signed report gives the inspections and the records behind them, each scheduled inspection due against an inspection entry of its room in its window, each violation past its correction date against a correction entry, each inspection entry against the rooms and age groups the facility record identifies, and each violation against the inspection entry it was cited under, and counts them, and names divergent childcare inspection records: an inspection the schedule requires with no entry behind it, a violation past its correction date with no correction entry, an inspection entry for a room or age group the facility record does not identify, and a violation with no inspection entry behind it; then a correction dated before its violation was cited and a correction naming a violation the record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No inspection entries, or no rooms beside inspected rooms, leaves those points unverified. Rooms, inspections, violations and entries match by letters and digits, age groups by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, a schedule entry naming no room is met by an inspection of any room, and an inspection or correction due after the reading moment waits. This reads the inspection record kept on a licensed childcare facility, from the schedule to each violation’s correction. Verdict childcare_inspection_record_divergent, childcare_inspection_record_partial, childcare_inspection_record_unverified or childcare_inspection_record_consistent. POST /api/childcare-inspection-record-check. Reads the childcare records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no childcare facility, contacts no licensing agency or parent, runs no background check on anyone and issues no license, credential or certification, which stay with the operator and the licensing agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Childcare Records reads licensed childcare facility and staff compliance records, for childcare centers and family childcare homes, and never a record about an individual child: health records belong to Agent Healthcare, education records belong to Agent Education, food-safety records belong to Agent Food Safety Records, staff checks read the licensing qualification file and never run background checks, and pet daycare is not childcare (Agent Veterinary Records reads animal records). It reads a childcare operator’s own compliance paper: the childcare facility record with its license and license conditions, the licensing agency’s childcare inspection record, the childcare staff record with training entries, each childcare credential as issued, the childcare enrollment record and the childcare ratio record as counts, the childcare incident record from its date, type, notification and filing fields, and the childcare safety record with the emergency plan, each against the inspection, enrollment, condition, schedule, violation, requirement, qualification, placement, reliance, capacity, staffing, notification, drill and corrective action records it answers to. The family’s ground is the childcare facility’s paper trail: what the facility record and its license claim, whether the inspections hold up, what the staff and credential records support, what the enrollment and ratio counts show, and whether the incident log and the safety record line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-childcare-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-childcare-records/.
